verdicts.title: Merge credits claimable TITN with no check against TITN balance; late depositors lose TGT

a.reden: Both describe the same missing check that allows claimable TITN/TGT to exceed the contract's hard‑coded balance, causing later claims to fail.

b.reden: Both describe the same root cause: no limit on TGT deposits exceeding the hardcoded TITN amount, causing later claimers to lose TGT.

verdicts.title: Anyone can permanently flag any address as bridged-token holder, locking its transfers

a.reden: The candidate describes a different contract and issue unrelated to the known MergeTgt overflow finding.

b.reden: The candidate describes a different vulnerability in a different function and contract (Titn.sol _credit) than the known finding (MergeTgt exchange limit).

verdicts.title: Owner withdraw() can pull TITN that backs user claims, including after the post-1-year snapshot

a.reden: The candidate describes an owner‑withdraw misuse, while the known finding concerns missing limits on TGT exchange causing overflow in withdrawRemainingTitn; different root causes and functions.

b.reden: The candidate describes owner withdrawal of TITN backing claims, while H-01 concerns exceeding the hardcoded TGT exchange cap causing claimable TITN to exceed balance and overflow.

verdicts.title: withdrawRemainingTitn can underflow/brick if TITN balance is below total claimable

a.reden: Both describe the overflow/underflow in withdrawRemainingTitn caused by over‑subscription of TGT leading to claimable amount exceeding contract balance

b.reden: Both describe the same underflow in withdrawRemainingTitn caused by TGT over-subscription making claimable TITN exceed the contract's actual TITN balance.

verdicts.title: Leftover-TITN bonus is shared pro rata to claimable, so dust or late depositors capture unmerged TITN

a.reden: The candidate describes a bonus distribution issue, not the hard‑coded TGT limit overflow described in H‑01

b.reden: The candidate finding describes a different issue (distribution of leftover TITN proportional to claimable amounts) than the known finding (exceeding TGTTOEXCHANGE causing overflow).

verdicts.title: No minimum-output protection; deposits can yield zero TITN and TGT is lost

a.reden: The candidate describes a missing minimum-output check leading to zero token output, which is a different root cause than the known finding about exceeding hardcoded TGT limits and overflow.

b.reden: The candidate describes missing minimum-output protection and zero quoteTitn due to rate decay/rounding, while H-01 concerns exceeding the hardcoded TGT exchange amount and resulting claim/overflow is

verdicts.title: Early claimTitn() forfeits the user's share of the leftover bonus, so claimants are treated unequally

a.reden: The candidate describes an unequal bonus distribution due to early claims, which is unrelated to the TGTTOEXCHANGE limit and overflow issue of H-01.

b.reden: The candidate describes unequal bonus treatment from early claiming, while H-01 concerns exceeding hardcoded exchange limits causing claim failures/overflow in withdrawRemainingTitn.

verdicts.title: Titn restrictions depend on transferAllowedContract being set to MergeTgt, and the default blocks claimTitn on Arbitrum

a.reden: The candidate describes a transfer restriction bug, while the known finding concerns overflow and excess TGT handling, so they are unrelated.

b.reden: The candidate describes transfer restrictions blocking claims when transferAllowedContract is unset, while H-01 concerns exceeding hardcoded exchange limits and an overflow in withdrawRemainingTitn.
